name: PM-USP – Central Sector Scheme Of Scholarship For College And University Students (CSSS)
ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education

all_of.text: Above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream in Class XII.
Pursuing a regular degree course; correspondence/distance is not eligible.
Studying in an institution recognized by the applicable regulatory body.
Gross parental/family income up to Rs. 4.5 lakh per annum.
Not availing another merit/state scholarship, fee waiver or reimbursement scheme.

benefit.text: Financial assistance under PM-USP CSSS; the applicable amount depends on the course/year and is governed by the current scheme guidelines.

deadline.note: AY 2026-27 fresh student application closed on 30-09-2026; renewal student application remains open till 31-10-2026.
